feeds.title: Crowntown Cannabis Blog
feeds.description: Crowntown Cannabis is a company formed by three best friends born and raised in Charlotte, North Carolina. After losing too many loved ones to harmful drugs and chemicals, Mike, Dan and Lindsay set out with a goal to make a change in their community and in the world. Crowntown Cannabis serves to educate people about the benefits of CBD, help people with our products, and end the stigma surrounding cannabis.
